def choose_move(observation):
    pos = observation.get('self_position', (0, 0))
    width = observation.get('grid_width', 1)
    height = observation.get('grid_height', 1)
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    obstacles = set(observation.get('obstacles', []))
    opp = observation.get('opponent_position', (0, 0))
    my_x, my_y = pos
    opp_x, opp_y = opp
    
    # Move towards nearest resource if available
    if resources:
        target = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r.get('pos', (0,0))[0]-my_x)+abs(r.get('pos', (0,0))[1]-my_y))
        tx, ty = target.get('pos', (0,0))
        dx = (tx - my_x)
        dy = (ty - my_y)
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
    else:
        # Otherwise, move away from opponent
        dx = (my_x - opp_x)
        dy = (my_y - opp_y)
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)

    # Clamp move within grid and avoid obstacles
    new_x = my_x + dx
    new_y = my_y + dy
    if new_x < 0 or new_x >= width or new_x, new_y in obstacles:
        dx = 0
    if new_y < 0 or new_y >= height or (new_x, new_y) in obstacles:
        dy = 0
    return [dx, dy]
